title: dengueriskcdmx (Python): Data and Rasters for the Dengue Transmission Risk Map of the Mexico City Metropolitan Area
description: Python version of the dengueriskcdmx R package, exported from it. Provides the Aedes aegypti ovitrap data (2017–2024, with training and test partitions), the external validation data (2025) and the study area as GeoDataFrames, and the rasters (about 500 m) of the probability of Aedes aegypti occurrence, the probability of confirmed imported dengue cases and the five-level epidemiological risk map. Confirmed dengue case data are not distributed.
